# pdf-lib browser bundle

- Package: `pdf-lib`
- Version: `1.17.1`
- Source: `https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js`
- SHA-256: `72c052d97b4d5d9fa6cdbdcb7ad709f03d4ddb1122390cb3afeba4d88651d969`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md` in this directory.

The checked-in ESM bundle is used locally for multi-page PDF assembly and
vector PDF basemap composition. It avoids a runtime dependency on a public CDN.
